Extract the Variables Declared in a Define-XML File

Source: R/define_consistency.R
define_variables.Rd

Returns one row per variable declared in Define-XML, following the ItemGroupDef to ItemRef to ItemDef structure: the dataset name comes from the ItemGroupDef, and the variable name from the ItemDef its ItemRef points at. Elements are matched by local name, so the result does not depend on how the file mixes the ODM and def: namespaces.

Usage

define_variables(file)

Arguments

file

Path to a Define-XML file.

Value

A data.frame with columns dataset and variable.

See also

check_define_consistency().
